test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

_____ the boys were afraid at heart, they decided to stay on in the jungle.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Although**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill the given blank is '**Although**'.
 
• It means **'in spite of the fact that**'.
 
 
• *Example: **Although** she was tired, she stayed up late watching television.*
 
 
 
• You use '**although**' to introduce a **'subordinate clause'** that contains a statement that makes the **'main clause'** of the sentence seem surprising or unexpected.
 
• The given sentence is trying to express the fact that in spite of the fact that the boys were afraid, they decided to stay in the jungle.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** ***Although** the boys were afraid at heart, they decided to stay on in the jungle.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प '**Although**' है।
 
• इसका अर्थ है 'यद्यपि, हालाँकि'।
 
 
• *Example: **Although** she was tired, she stayed up late watching television.*
 
 
 
• आप '**Although**' का उपयोग **'subordinate clause'** को पेश करने के लिए करते हैं जिसमें एक बयान होता है जो वाक्य के** 'main clause'** को आश्चर्यजनक या अप्रत्याशित लगता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य इस तथ्य को व्यक्त करने का प्रयास कर रहा है कि लड़कों के डरने के बावजूद उन्होंने जंगल में रहने का फैसला किया।
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है।
